Name: WorkBuddy
Overview: Control WorkBuddy with keys and dials: launch the client, draft tasks, switch models, read chats and credits, and manage the current session through local CDP.

Localization.guide_0: Your AI workspace, one press away.
Localization.guide_3: Install WorkBuddy Desktop. Drag Launch WorkBuddy onto a key. The inspector checks the client, status sync and current state.
Localization.guide_6: Press Launch WorkBuddy to start in CDP mode. When connected, bring the client forward. When disconnected, start or restart in CDP mode.
Localization.guide_8: Once the inspector shows Connected, use Voice Input, Send Message, Current Session Status and Switch Theme.
Localization.guide_9: Read the key at a glance
Localization.guide_13: Thinking, using tools or compacting context.
Localization.guide_15: The task completed and its conversation-list notification is unread. Reading it clears the alert.
Localization.guide_17: Waiting for a permission decision or an answer. Use the current-session dial to choose an action.
Localization.guide_19: The conversation reports an error or execution failure. Check the cause in WorkBuddy.
Localization.guide_26: Start or restart the client in CDP mode when disconnected; bring it forward when connected.
Localization.guide_28: Show the five most recent loaded WorkBuddy tasks. Press to open the displayed chat.
Localization.guide_30: Set a prompt template with {clipboard}, {date} and {time}, plus directory, expert, skills, connectors and model. Maximum 8000 characters.
Localization.guide_32: Choose projects, skills, connectors, automation and more. Open Task requires a task ID. Unsupported pages may remain unchanged or return home; cloud files may share the file list.
Localization.guide_34: Enable CDP and open the task composer. Turn the dial to switch models. No model IDs are needed.
Localization.guide_36: Enable CDP to follow the current chat. Turn to select Allow once, Allow for this session, or Deny, then press to submit. Unavailable choices are dimmed. Question dialogs show their actual options, with single or multiple choices, previous/next, submit and skip. Other brings the client forward for typing. Entered answers can be submitted from the dial. Custom dialogs require separate support.
Localization.guide_38: Choose a local image per key. The key displays a 96×96 preview. Press to apply via CDP. Press again to restore the default theme.
Localization.guide_40: Enable CDP. Press Voice Input to start or finish recording. Press Send Message to send the current draft, or to stop the current response when Stop is shown. Gray means unavailable.
Localization.guide_42: Show remaining account credits on a key or encoder through CDP every 30 seconds. Press to refresh. A gray dash indicates a disconnected or unavailable balance.
Localization.guide_43: New Task only prefills a draft; you confirm sending. The domestic client uses workbuddy://; WorkBuddy AI uses workbuddy-ai://.
Localization.guide_45: Open the Launch WorkBuddy setup and select Restart WorkBuddy. Click to start or restart WorkBuddy directly. On Windows this forcibly ends processes from the selected installation and may interrupt tasks; save work first. macOS quits normally before reopening. The status source shows CDP after connection and shows Disconnected if the connection drops.

Click Restart WorkBuddy to launch the client with CDP enabled.
